NewsArticle.Title: Dark Ages Expansion
NewsArticle.Content: ... May - July We are creating Dark Ages' largest expansion, ever! We will add features one at a time, for continuous, new, high-quality entertainment. Expansion includes: - 100+ new realms with new graphics: - Haunted Estate - Cthonic Realm - Icy Wasteland - 30+ new monsters - 400+ new items: - 80+ new clothing variations - 10+ new clothes - 10+ new weapons, including axes, clubs, and hammer - 100+ new simple items - Regional political uniforms - Religious staves and symbols - New hats and accessories - New interactive epic events - 40 new hairstyles [Screenshot.](http://www1.darkages.com/pics/s_cthonic.html) More screenshots will be posted as we finish features. I will post expansion news updates as soon as development and testing allow. Check [www.darkages.com/news](http://www.darkages.com/news) for the latest. - Dave Kennerly, Game Director View [all features screenshots.](http://www.darkages.com/pics/index_feature.html)
